payload.claim: This comment explains why scope_proposal.json's envelope carries its own sha256 field by saying it is 'because plan.json is redacted.' That is not the actual reason: scope_proposal.json needs its own hash because it wraps the raw text inside a JSON envelope (so sha256sum of the file does not equal the embedded hash of the raw field), which was true before this change and is unrelated to plan.json's redaction. The new wording attaches an unrelated cause to the fact it is explaining.
